description: This Java source file defines the ByteArray utility class for byte array operations in Apache Spark, including memory manipulation, comparison, substring extraction, concatenation, and padding.

classes.name: ByteArray
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for byte array operations such as memory writing, comparison, substring, concatenation, and padding.

methods.name: writeToMemory
methods.description: Copies byte array content into a specified memory address.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Generates a 64-bit prefix for sorting based on byte array content.

methods.name: compareBinary
methods.description: Compares two byte arrays lexicographically as unsigned bytes.

methods.name: subStringSQL
methods.description: Extracts a substring from a byte array based on position and length, considering UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: concat
methods.description: Concatenates multiple byte arrays into one.

methods.name: concatWS
methods.description: Concatenates multiple byte arrays with a delimiter.

methods.name: lpad
methods.description: Left-pads a byte array to a specified length with a pattern.

methods.name: rpad
methods.description: Right-pads a byte array to a specified length with a pattern.
